text_events.text: Some versions of you only exist after departure.

production_notes: Open on the departure-board terminal view, move to the traveler, and end above the clouds.
Keep the edit cinematic and restrained; no heavy effects or fast transitions.
The procedural score supplies a gentle transition pulse without copyrighted music.
Curated Pexels material must not be described as personally filmed.
Human visual and audio approval is required before scheduling.

instagram.caption: Leaving is not always running away. Sometimes it is how you meet the next version of yourself.
instagram.music_search: In Instagram or Edits, search for cinematic departure, hopeful ambient build, or restrained travel pulse.
instagram.music_reuse_policy: Reuse on Facebook only when Meta confirms clearance for both placements.
instagram.schedule_notes: Use the Reel with the full opening sentence visible immediately; select BETWEEN HERE / THERE as the cover.

facebook.caption: Leaving is not always running away. Sometimes it is how you meet the next version of yourself. Are you a window-seat person or an aisle-seat person?

facebook.music_reuse_policy: Confirm Facebook clearance before reusing Instagram music.
facebook.schedule_notes: Facebook Reel; keep the reflective copy intact and use the same cover.

tiktok.caption: POV: you booked the ticket instead of overthinking it.

tiktok.schedule_notes: Use the POV line as the post caption; do not add template effects over the existing edit.

checklist: Watch both MP4 masters and confirm the terminal-to-traveler-to-clouds progression is clear.
Inspect cover and contact sheet; confirm the long opening text is readable inside safe margins.
Confirm source pages, creators, license evidence, and SHA-256 hashes in manifest.json.
Confirm 1080 x 1920, H.264, 10.5-second duration, and audio-stream checks passed.
Confirm there is no watermark, false personal-filming claim, or unlicensed external audio.
Add platform music natively and record the actual track in this file.
Verify caption, CTA, hashtags, cover, date, time zone, and preview before scheduling.
